title: 리뷰 — ETXTBSY 수정(place_exe)

text:
/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD 원문

I found no real bugs in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (f26259e, plus the tracker lines that aren't committed yet), so there was nothing to fix. I couldn't call ReportFindings because it isn't among my tools, and I made no changes to the working tree.

What I checked in `tests/cli.rs`:
- **Does `place_exe` actually remove the race?** Yes. The write fd to the file that later gets exec'd now lives only inside the `cp` process. Other test threads fork this process, not `cp`, so they can't inherit it. `.output()` waits for `cp` to exit, and a process closes its fds before it can be reaped, so nothing is still writing the file when it gets exec'd.
- **The fake `claude` script source (`claude.sh`)** is still written by this process, but it is never exec'd; `cp` only reads it. A stray inherited fd on it can't cause ETXTBSY.
- **Mode is kept.** `cp` without `-p` gives a new file the source's mode minus the umask, so the 0o755 script and cargo's 0755 binary stay executable. `runnable`'s `& 0o111` check in `src/cmd/skill.rs` still passes.
- **No other file is written and then exec'd.** `noexec-moai` is never run, the `sh` in `sysbin` is a symlink to `/bin/sh`, and `survives_a_closed_pipe` runs `BIN` through `bash -c`. Nothing in `src` sets permissions or copies binaries.
- **The tests mean the same thing.** Both destinations (`bin/claude`, `otherbin/moai`) are new files, so `cp` never truncates a binary that is running. The extra `claude.sh` at the HOME root is not seen by any `read_dir` or listing check.
- **They pass.** `cargo test --release --test cli skill_` ran 13 passed, 0 failed. I ran it once; I didn't repeat the author's 40-run stress loop.

One tracker note, not a code bug: the title of `moai-4v8w` still proposes the fix as "rename 으로 내놓는다", and the commit shows that approach doesn't work. The note on the issue explains why, but the title could be updated when the issue is closed.
판단: 지적된 코드 결함 없음 — 코드 fix 커밋 없음. 반영 1건: 제목이 효과 없는 'rename' 을 처방으로 적고 있어 moai-4v8w 제목을 실제 수정(cp 자식 프로세스)으로 고쳤다. 넘긴 것 없음. 리뷰어가 스트레스 반복을 안 돌린 것은 수정 뒤 cli 40/40·cargo test 5/5 로 이미 재 두었다(moai-4v8w 노트).

note: 결함 없음. moai-4v8w 제목을 rename 에서 cp 수정으로 고쳐 반영, 넘긴 것 없음
복사본 exec 의 ETXTBSY 를 확인(40 번 중 12)하고 cp 자식이 쓰게 해 없앴다 — rename 은 inode 가 같아 소용없다

text: 정한 것. (1) id 는 닫는 함수가 `Touched { id, done }` 로 댄다 — 새 id 는 락 안의 목록으로 고르므로 쓰는 쪽만 알고, 쓰기 전후 목록을 견주면 같은 틈의 남의 쓰기와 갈리지 않는다. 제네릭 T 는 걷었다: 쓰고 나면 화면이 다시 읽혀 id 로 무엇이든 찾을 수 있다. (2) 뒤처리는 write 가 한다 — retry 로 이어진 쓰기도 같다. (3) 다른 디렉터리면 home_of 로 가고 묶음이어도 안에 안 들어간다. (4) 거름망이 가리면 커서·길·거름망 모두 그대로 두고 알림에 말한다(대신 풀지 않는다). (5) notice 는 trouble 과 따로 든다(담긴 뒤 읽기 실패면 둘 다 참). 배너 차례: trouble → notice → 못 읽는 줄 → 드러난 것 → 옆 워크트리. 다음 키에 걷히고, 알림 하나뿐이면 `!` 를 안 붙인다. (6) 앞말은 부르는 쪽이 정한다 — 필드 고치기는 저널이 없어 저널에서 못 읽는다. 목록 셈: reload 한 번(take 가 rows 한 번) + land 가 새 자리의 rows 한 번. 데이터 다시 읽기는 한 번이다.

title: 리뷰 — 쓴 뒤 커서 두기와 한 줄 알림

text:
/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD (19e3279) 원문

I found no real bugs in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (19e3279, moai-064q: after a write the cursor lands on the line it made and a one-line notice names it), so `--fix` had nothing to apply and I didn't change any files. The ReportFindings tool isn't available in this session, so this reply is the report.

Checks run: `cargo build --release` passed with no warnings, so the `expect(dead_code)` markers on `Touched`, `Landing` and `land` are all needed. `cargo test --bin moai tui::` passed: 131 passed, 1 ignored.

What I checked in `src/tui/mod.rs` and `src/tui/draw.rs`, with nothing wrong found:
- **Landing in another directory:** `land` uses the path that `Index::home_of` gives the line. Without a filter, every line can be reached from the root. With a filter, `entries_where` keeps a directory if anything under it matches. So "hidden" can only mean a filter (search or 거름망) is hiding the line, and the notice saying so is accurate. On "hidden", `path` goes back to where it was and nothing else changes.
- **Remembered cursor positions:** they are cut back to the part of the path that didn't change, then filled with zeros to the new depth. `leave` looks for the directory it came out of first, so those zeros are only used as a fallback.
- **Detail scroll reset:** it only resets when the cursor ends up on a different line. After `reload`, `take` already keeps the cursor on the line it was on, or resets the scroll itself if that line is gone. So "same row number in the same directory" really does mean the same line.
- **When the notice goes away:**
  - `write` clears it first, so a failed write can't show the previous write's `✓`.
  - `key()` clears it on the next key. The event loop only passes key presses, not releases, so it isn't wiped immediately.
  - After a name prompt, the Enter that answers it clears the old notice, and the resumed write then sets its own.
- **Reread failure after a write:** a new id then lands as "missing" (`다시 읽은 목록에 없다`). The banner puts the failure first, and the ✓ is still true because the file was written.
- **Banner:** the `!` is dropped only when the notice is the only thing in the banner. Priority order is kept, and the red "urgent" colour comes only from real trouble.

Two things I left alone on purpose:
- **Duplicate ids:** the index keeps the last copy of a repeated id. New ids are picked inside the write lock and can't collide, so this can't happen yet. It could matter once edit writes arrive (the `n` form, moai-11s4).
- **Screen jump:** the banner row appears when a notice is set and disappears on the next key, so the list moves by one row. That follows the existing rule that the banner row only exists when there is something to say; it's cosmetic.

title: 리뷰 — 시험 격리 도우미 isolated() 와 누설 증명 시험

text:
## 리뷰 원문 (/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD, de4a21c)

I reviewed `HEAD~1..HEAD` (only `tests/cli.rs`) and found 3 problems. I fixed all three and skipped nothing. The ReportFindings tool isn't available in this session, so the findings are listed here.

**Findings**

1. `tests/cli.rs:50` (medium): `isolated()` blocks the global and system git config files, but not git config passed in through the environment, or the variables that point git at a repository.
   - If `cargo test` runs from inside a git hook, or under something like `git -c user.name=X rebase -x 'cargo test'`, git hands those variables down to the tests.
   - moai's `git config user.name` would then pick up the outer person's name. The "who is it" tests would quietly test something else, and the leak probe test can't catch it.
   - The `git()` helper had the same gap, and it's worse there: with an inherited `GIT_DIR`, its `git commit` would land in the outer repository.
2. `tests/cli.rs:~1231` (low): inside the new leak test, the `bare` add step only checks that the command failed. If `add` failed for some unrelated reason, the test would still pass while proving nothing.
3. `tests/cli.rs:~1287` (low): the outer check that the planted git name really shows up clears the environment, which also removes `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM`. On a machine whose `/etc/gitconfig` already has a user name, the check passes without the planted file, so it proves nothing.

**What I changed in `tests/cli.rs`**

- **For 1:**
  - Added a `GIT_LEAKS` list that `isolated()` removes from the environment: `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`, `GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS`, `GIT_DIR`, `GIT_WORK_TREE`, `GIT_COMMON_DIR`, `GIT_INDEX_FILE`, `GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY`, `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES`, `GIT_NAMESPACE`, `GIT_PREFIX`.
  - Documented the reason in the function's doc comment.
  - The `git()` helper now starts from `isolated("git")` instead of `Command::new("git")`, so it gets the same protection.
- **For 2:** the test also checks that the output contains "git 사용자 정보가 없다", so it only passes when moai stopped because it couldn't find a user.
- **For 3:** the outer check now sets `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`.

After the changes, `cargo test --test cli` passes (207 tests). I couldn't actually run the tests with the git environment variables injected: the worktree sandbox refuses commands that set `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`. Finding 1 therefore rests on git's documented behaviour, not on a reproduction.

The fixes are uncommitted in `tests/cli.rs`. They should go in as a separate `fix:` commit, per the repo's rule for review follow-ups.

title: 리뷰 — 막음 판정을 report::blocker 하나로 모으기

text:
## code-review high --fix — d571d69~1..0004e01 (원문)

**Findings**

1. `src/tui/draw.rs:601` (medium) — **the "미룸" word on a deferred blocker line gets cut off.** The detail line is built as `· {b}  {title}  · {shelf}`, and `field()` trims values from the right. The right pane is about 45% of the screen, so at 120 columns a title of ordinary length fills the room and the whole `미룸 …` part is dropped. That word is the only thing that tells a deferred blocker apart from an ordinary "막힘" line, and it's the whole reason this branch exists. The new test didn't catch it because its blocker title was the very short "미룰 일". I checked this: with a longer title, `the_detail_blocker_lines_agree_with_ready` fails with "미뤄 둔 막음: `미룸` 가 없다".
2. `src/tui/draw.rs:590` (low, cleanup) — `title_of(b)` allocates a string that the `Missing` arm never uses, and `deferred_root(b)` is looked up twice.

**Fixes applied** (only `src/tui/draw.rs` changed)
- The deferral word now comes before the title: `· {b}  {shelf}  {title}`. If the line is too long, the title gets trimmed, and the trim is marked.
- `deferred_root(b)` is looked up once, and `title_of` is only called in the arms that show a title.
- The blocker in the test's deferred case now has a normal-length title, so the test fails if the word is cut again.
- `cargo test --release` passes (478 unit + 206 CLI). `cargo clippy` shows one warning, which was already there and is outside this diff (`report.rs:2802`, needless lifetimes).

**Checked, nothing wrong**
- `report::blocker` refactor: `is_blocked` and `deferred_blockers` behave the same as before for all four cases (Missing, Done, Deferred, Open).
- Explorer inputs match `ready`: `App::column` gives the same answer as `report::column` (both from `group_states`); `Index::deferred_root` gives the same answer as `deferred_roots_in`; for duplicate ids, `Index::find` and report's `by_id` both pick the last row.
- CLI wording: the CLI `show` doesn't print `blocked_by` lines, so the new "끊김" / "미룸" words have nothing on the CLI side to disagree with.

**Watch out:** running `cargo fmt` here reformats about 40 files, because the code isn't kept in default rustfmt style. (The reviewer ran it by accident, reverted src and tests to HEAD, then re-applied only the fix above.)

I found no bugs in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (a3ad753, `src/tui/draw.rs`), so there was nothing to fix and nothing to skip. I couldn't submit through the ReportFindings tool because it isn't available in this session, so this reply is the whole report.

The commit stops the key bar from listing Enter and Bksp when the detail pane has focus. What I checked:

Enter is pressed on the epic at the root and Bksp inside the epic, so "the screen changed" is a real signal. At 120 columns the full bar (101 columns) fits, so a missing label can't be blamed on width.

title: 리뷰 — 글칸 줄의 오류 몫 나누기

text:
## /code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD (원문)

I found one real issue in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (`src/tui/draw.rs`, moai-1vjh) and fixed it in the working tree. It's a small display regression on very narrow windows. The ReportFindings tool isn't available in this session, so the finding is listed here only.

**Finding**
- `src/tui/draw.rs:244` (`prompt_room`), low severity — on a narrow window the input field is shrunk to a third even when the error gets no room at all. So the error is hidden anyway and most of the typed text disappears too. Example: a 14-cell-wide window with the " 거름망 " label leaves 5 cells. The field drops to 1 cell and the error gets 0 cells. With the cursor at the end, none of the typed text shows and no error shows either; before this change, 4 characters were visible. The same waste happens whenever the error would get 0 cells after the field keeps its third.

**Fixed**
- `prompt_room` now returns `(avail, 0)` when the error would get 0 cells, so the field is never shrunk for nothing. I kept the case where the error gets just 1 cell: a red `…` still tells the user something is wrong. I added a doc line saying why.
- `the_prompt_room_never_overflows` now also checks that when the error gets 0 cells, the field keeps the full width.
- The doc comment on `filter_line` described the extra return values of `filter_cells`. I moved that description onto `filter_cells`.

**Checked, no problem**
- The line never overflows: the field, the 4-cell gap and the clipped error always fit in the width after the label.
- The cursor always sits after the label and inside the line, including when the field is 0 cells.
- `clip(&e, 0)` returns an empty string, so nothing spills past the line.
- The short-input and help lines draw exactly as before.
- The "누구" (who are you) prompt goes through the same code and is fine.

Tests: `cargo test --release --bin moai tui::` passed 140, 0 failed. Nothing is committed; the change is in the working tree.

판단 — 반영: 좁은 창에서 오류가 0 칸을 받는데도 글칸을 삼분의 일로 줄이던 것(친 글만 가려짐) — 8ecf22c. 오류가 한 칸이라도 받으면 줄인다(빨간 … 이 틀렸다는 뜻을 진다). 시험 문서 자리 옮김도 같은 커밋. 넘긴 것 없음. 리뷰가 안 친 것 중 이쪽이 정해 둔 것: 안내(Enter·Esc)는 몫을 안 받아서 긴 글에서 오류가 서고 걷힐 때 조각이 밀렸다 돌아온다 — 상태 없이 막으려면 안내에도 몫을 줘야 하는데 그러면 오류 없는 긴 글이 늘 좁아진다. f3be033 본문과 prompt 주석에 적었다.

note: 반영: 오류가 0 칸이면 글칸을 안 줄인다(8ecf22c). 넘긴 것 없음

title: 리뷰 — 묶음 스핀 규칙(App::spins·Stand::busy)

text:
/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD (2d4e182, "묶음은 그 밑에 집은 일이 있을 때만 돈다")

**Findings:** none.

**What I checked:**
- **Busy vs. column:** `busy` counts the same members as the column calculation (`counted`). So a group can't spin while its column is `todo` or `done`, and a member skipped because it was deferred can't make a group spin. When the group itself is deferred, its members still count, which is consistent.
- **Unusual status configs:** spinning is hardcoded to `in_progress`, and a group only reads `in_progress` when that is its started column. I tried a two-column config (`busy` is always false), `in_progress` as the first column, and `review` before `in_progress`. The group row and its member rows never disagree about spinning in a way that is wrong.
- **Drawing vs. waking:** `App::spinning` is now built from `App::spins`, the same check the drawing code uses (`draw::glyph_of`). The list row and the detail header both go through `glyph_of`. So nothing can spin without waking the loop, or wake it without spinning. For work items the check is the same as before.
- **`--worktree`:** the overlaid lines go into `states_of` in `prepare`, so members picked up in another worktree do spin the group, as the comment says.
- **Compile check:** `Stand` is only built in one place, so adding the `busy` field breaks no other code.
- **Tests:** `cargo test` passes (484 unit and 206 CLI tests).

**Fixed:** one outdated doc comment, not a bug. In `src/tui/mod.rs:240`, the `App.states` comment still pointed to `report::group_states` and mentioned only the column. It now points to `report::group_stands` and mentions the "has a picked-up member" flag too.

**Skipped:** nothing.

title: 리뷰 — 버린 다시 읽기 손잡이 되던지기

text:
/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD (f5d1c29) 원문

I found one real bug in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (f5d1c29) and fixed it in the working tree. It isn't committed yet. The ReportFindings tool wasn't available in this session, so the finding is only listed here.

**Finding**
- `src/tui/mod.rs:426` — low severity. When the list of discarded read threads is already full, `reload` drops the oldest one without checking whether it has finished. Cleanup of finished threads only happens at the start of each `follow` step. A thread that was still running at the last step can panic before the next F5, `w` or write. If that thread is the oldest one, `reload` drops it and its panic is lost. The terminal has already been reset by then, so the loop goes on drawing to a broken screen, which is the exact problem this commit set out to fix.

**Fix**
- In `reload`, when the list is full, finished threads are now cleaned up (and a panic re-thrown) before the oldest is dropped.
- To make that compile I had to split how `repo` is borrowed: the early return now checks `self.repo.is_none()`, and `repo` is read only after the cleanup.
- New test `a_full_discard_list_reaps_before_it_lets_go_of_the_oldest` fills the list with a panicked thread plus 7 blocked ones and presses F5. It fails without the fix and passes with it.
- The full `cargo test --release` passes (485 unit and 206 CLI tests), and clippy is clean.

**Checked and fine**
- An unfinished thread never makes the loop wait.
- A discarded read that finishes normally doesn't start another read, because F5 already updated the change marker.
- Discarding only happens while a read is running, and the loop already wakes every 30ms then, so the new fast wake covers the window after F5.
- The swappable `read` field only changes what tests run, not the real read path.

**Noted, not changed**
- If discarded threads truly hang, the loop keeps waking every 30ms to redraw and re-check the files for as long as they live. The commit chose this on purpose, and a hung background read already kept the loop at 30ms before this change, so I left it.

**Files touched:** `src/tui/mod.rs`. The `.moai/*` changes were already in the working tree before the review (the review issue `moai-r27k.fkt`). Per CLAUDE.md, this fix should go in its own `fix:` commit.

판단 — 1(꽉 찬 목록에서 가장 오래된 것을 거두지 않고 놓아 패닉을 잃음): 반영, f865be0. 수정은 리뷰어가 낸 그대로 두었다 — repo 를 두 번 보는 것은 reap 이 &mut self 라 빌림을 가르려는 것이다. 넘김: 버린 스레드가 정말 멈추면 루프가 30ms 로 계속 깨 stat 한다 — 의도한 것이다. 버리기 전 짓던 읽기가 멈춰도 이미 30ms 로 깼고, 상한 8 이 스레드 수를 묶는다. 따로 이슈를 세우지 않는다.

note: 반영: 꽉 찬 버린 목록에서 놓기 전에 거두기(f865be0). 넘김: 멈춘 스레드 동안 30ms 깨기는 의도 — 이슈 없음
버린 다시 읽기 손잡이를 8개까지 들고 follow 가 걸음마다 끝난 것을 join 해 패닉을 되던진다

title: 리뷰 — 부모가 묶음이면 소속 (moai-9t3l)

text:
리뷰 원문 — /code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD (971bffb)

I found no correctness bugs in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (971bffb, moai-9t3l). There is one low-severity finding, a condition that can never matter, and I fixed it.

Findings
- `src/report.rs:819` (low, cleanup): in `climb`, the check `!std::ptr::eq(cur, top)` never changes the result. When `joins` is true, the starting line comes from `fold_top`, which only climbs through issues and ideas, so it is never a milestone. It also compared pointers where the rest of the code works with ids, which reads as if duplicate ids were a concern. I removed it and added a one-line comment saying why the milestone reached there is always an ancestor. `cargo test --release` passes (516 unit + 209 CLI).

What I checked that holds up
- Same answer on every surface: the tree, the TUI, `show <epic>` and its `--json` members, the `-e`/`--milestone` filters, `status` warnings, the hook's unit rules (`unit_of`, rules 1 and 3) and deferral all read `report::groups` and `report::milestones`. None of them works out the epic from the parent id on its own. Every other `parent_of` call site checked.
- Precedence: the child's own `epic` wins, then the nearest ancestor's field, then an epic ancestor. The epic check runs before that ancestor's own `epic` field is read, so an epic line's `epic` field is never passed down. A child's own `milestone` also beats a milestone ancestor.
- Ideas: an idea directly under an epic becomes a root-level idea but still belongs to the epic. Hanging at root, membership, and deferral agree.
- Duplicate ids: `by_id` and `kind_of` both let the later line win, so a value is only returned when that later line really is an epic.

Skipped (behaviour decision A intends, not bugs)
- `moai show <epic>` now lists an id-child such as a review twice: on the "자식" line and in the member list. It was in the "자식" line before too; the member entry is new.
- `moai edit <E.c> -e none` clears the field but leaves the child in epic `E`. Under decision A, a child created with `--parent <epic>` can be moved to another epic but can never be taken out of epics entirely.

(b) edit <E.c> -e none 이 소속을 못 끊는 것은 이슈 밑 자식에서 이미 있던 물려받음과 같은 모양이고 결정 A 가 뜻한 것이지만, 조용한 것은 적어 둘 만해 idea moai-feyv 로 담았다. 실제 점검: 이 리뷰 줄(moai-9t3l.m8c)이 show -e moai-0xp7 에 선다.

text:
리뷰 원문 (/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD, 224e93b)

I reviewed `HEAD~1..HEAD` (224e93b) and found two real bugs, both now fixed in the working tree. There's no ReportFindings tool in this session, so the findings are listed here only. The rest of the commit holds up: the last-row-wins changes in `groups` and `misplaced`, the rows `eclipsed` skips in `members_in`, `rollup_of` and `group_members`, and `creates_cycle` all give consistent results.

## Findings

1. **`src/query.rs:266` (medium): `moai show -e` / `--milestone` still pick a hidden row by its twin's membership.** The commit stopped a row from being drawn or counted with its twin's group (the "twin" is a same-id row of another kind, which hides it). The list filter still reads the id-keyed membership map. I confirmed it on the binary with three rows: epic `x-0001`, issue `x-0002` with no epic, and idea `x-0002` with `epic: x-0001`.
   - `moai show x-0001` says `멤버 0/0`.
   - `moai show --tree` puts the issue row under `(길 잃음)`.
   - `moai show -e x-0001` still lists that issue as a member.

   This breaks the rule in the comment right above that code, that the list picks what the tree shows. Before this commit the three commands agreed.

2. **`src/nav.rs:164` with `src/tui/draw.rs:708` (low): the TUI detail panel shows the twin's milestone for a lost row.** `Index::milestone_of` came from a map keyed by id. With rows `[A: issue, A: epic with milestone M, M: milestone]`, the issue row now sits in `(길 잃음)`, but its panel still says `마일스톤 M`, taken from the epic row. Before the commit that row really was drawn under M, so this is a regression.

## Fixes
- **`src/query.rs`:** `Where` now carries the `report::eclipsed` check. In `Filter::matches`, a hidden row matches no `-e` or `--milestone` selector, including `none`. That matches the tree (lost bucket) and the rollups (not counted in any group). Test added: `an_eclipsed_row_is_picked_by_no_membership`.
- **`src/nav.rs`:** `milestone_of` now takes the row index and reads that row's own tree position, so the id-keyed map is gone. The TUI panel calls it with `idx`. The regression assertion is in `a_twin_of_another_kind_does_not_share_its_verdict`.

All tests pass (518 unit, 209 CLI), and clippy reports nothing new in the touched files. Nothing is committed; the changes are ready for a separate `fix:` commit.

## Not fixed
Both need changes well outside the reviewed diff and are only visible on files that already carry the `duplicate_id` error:
- **Epic column in lists:** `report::epic_labels` is keyed by id, so the epic column in `show` and `ready` still prints the twin's epic title for a hidden row.
- **`no_epic` / `no_milestone` warnings:** they still count hidden rows using the twin's map value. So a hidden row can appear in the `no_epic` warning while the hint `moai show -e none` no longer lists it after fix 1.

판단: 지적 2건 모두 받는다 — 둘 다 224e93b 가 (길 잃음) 으로 옮긴 가려진 줄에 id 키 값이 남은 되돌림이다. 리뷰의 고침을 그대로 fix 커밋 a23254f 로 남겼다: query 소속 거름망이 report::eclipsed 로 가려진 줄을 어느 선택자(none 포함)에도 안 고르고, nav::Index::milestone_of 는 첨자로 물어 그 줄의 homes 에서 읽는다. 같은 커밋에 리뷰 moai-9p36.kqi 가 따로 짚은 같은 종류 groups 누수(앞줄 epic 이 에픽 없는 뒷줄에 남음)의 시험을 더했다 — 고침은 224e93b 에 이미 있었다. 넘긴 것 2건 → moai-9nl2(idea): report::epic_labels 의 에픽 칸과 no_epic/no_milestone 경고가 가려진 줄에 쌍둥이 값을 쓴다. duplicate_id(fatal) 파일에서만 보이고 status·목록 칸 두 자리를 같이 바꾸는 일이라 이 버그 범위 밖으로 둔다.

note: 지적 2건 반영(a23254f: 소속 거름망·TUI 상세 마일스톤). 넘김: 에픽 칸·no_epic 경고의 가려진 줄 → moai-9nl2

title: 리뷰 — 커밋된 안내 재생성과 드리프트 시험

text:
/code-review high --fix 원문 (5c24240..HEAD — 478e445 f126ef7 ae112b9 d440ac2, 합친 main 은 뺐다)

I found no real bugs in this range, so there was nothing for `--fix` to apply and the working tree is unchanged.

What I checked:

- Regenerated text: `AGENTS.md`, `SKILL.md` and `references/commands.md` now match `src/guide.rs` exactly. "읽기 전용" is gone from all of them, and the `--parent <에픽>` sentence appears in both the AGENTS block and commands.md.
- Version in `plugin.json` (19.483.272): it was computed from the committed hook path and marketplace name. The name `moai-moai-0cb7` is what `market("moai", /home/coder/workspace/moa-issue)` gives, so running `skill install` from the main checkout produces the same version. It doesn't pick up anything from the worktree.
- The `tree` → `tree_named` split: `tree()` still passes `market(prefix, root)` through, and `marketplace_json` puts the same name in both the file and the version hash. So `skill install` and `skill status` get the same version as before.
- `the_checked_in_agents_block_matches_the_guide`: `AGENTS.md` has both markers and ends with `<!-- moai:end -->\n`. Rebuilding the block with `with_block` gives back the same bytes, so the test doesn't fail when nothing changed. If the markers are missing, it fails and says to run `moai init`, which is the right fix.
- `the_checked_in_plugin_matches_the_guide`: `hook_exe` pulls the path back out of the command intact, because `command()` only writes paths that need no escaping. `MOAI_BLESS` writes into directories that already exist, and only this test reads those files, so running tests in parallel is safe.
- Tracker files: `moai-ka9p` went to `in_progress`, and the new review issue `moai-ka9p.lx7` inherits its epic from its parent. The journal line that the merge put out of order is harmless, since the journal isn't used to work out state.
- Tests: the full `cargo test --release` run passes (518 unit, 209 CLI).

Minor, not fixed:

- `src/skill.rs:650`: any value of `MOAI_BLESS` rewrites the files, including `MOAI_BLESS=0`. It's only a test switch, so I left it.
- `src/skill.rs:644`: if the committed `plugin.json` is broken, the test panics before the rewrite runs, so `MOAI_BLESS` can't repair that case. Restoring the file with `git checkout` or reinstalling covers it.

text:
리뷰 원문 (Fable, 범위 acdaf1e..8e156a7 — store/report/nav/tui 쓰기·재읽기 이음매, 보고만)

1. medium — src/report.rs:651-655 groups() 의 중복 id 접기가 milestones() 와 어긋난다.
   milestones() 는 못 받은 뒷줄도 지도를 쓴다(out.remove, 770-773)로 고쳤는데 groups() 는 filter_map().collect() 라 앞줄이 받은 epic 이 뒷줄의 빈 값에 덮이지 않는다.
   시나리오: argos-0002 두 줄, 앞줄 epic=argos-0001, 뒷줄(by_id·nav.find 가 고르는 줄) epic 없음 → groups 는 0002→0001, milestones 는 그 epic 의 마일스톤을 물려준다. nav 는 두 줄 다 0001 밑에 그리고 group_members 도 둘 다 센다(셈·그림은 맞음). 그러나 moai show argos-0002(뒷줄)는 에픽 없음 — CLI 와 TUI 가 다른 소속. 뒤집으면 문제 없음(비대칭).
   방향: groups() 도 Some→insert/None→remove 로 같은 접기, 또는 공통 helper.
2. low — src/tui/mod.rs:429-447 reload() 가 discarded 가 8 을 넘으면 아직 도는 스레드 손잡이를 remove(0) 으로 놓는다. 뒤에 패닉하면 걷힌 터미널에 계속 그린다(주석이 인정). 방향: 놓기 전 is_finished 재확인, 놓아야 하면 trouble 에 멈춘 스레드 수를 남긴다.
3. low — src/report.rs:783-800 climb() 이 마일스톤 줄 자신의 milestone 필드를 읽는다. milestones() 가 Kind::Milestone 줄도 fold_top→climb 로 보내 첫 걸음에서 cur.milestone 을 돌려준다 — 마일스톤이 다른 마일스톤에 속한다고 셈. nav 가 어디에 그리는지는 못 봄. 방향: Milestone 종류는 None 으로 못 박는다.

확인했고 괜찮은 것: new_id/admit 은 with_write 락 안에서만 불리고 정규화→검증→push→저널 순서가 한 곳; App::write↔Ask↔retry (모드를 먼저 되돌린 뒤 retry, 틀린 --user/MOAI_ACTOR 는 Ask 를 안 열어 무한 루프 없음); 쓰기→재읽기→stamp (읽기 전에 재고 pending 을 버린 뒤 동기 reload, write_failed 가 trouble 지우기를 막음); land (Hidden 이면 path 복원); blocker 가 is_blocked 와 deferred_blockers 에서 같은 답; Stand.busy 의 두 칸 설정 가드; nav::is_dir/kept 가 뒷줄 우선으로 milestones 와 같은 자; draw 의 as u16 캐스트 가드; follow 의 Disconnected 는 패닉일 때만.

보지 못한 것: draw.rs·scroll.rs·input.rs·edit.rs 본문; Landing::Hidden 알림의 "Esc 로 푼다" 가 실제 Esc 와 맞는지; model::actor(Some(user)) 가 MOAI_ACTOR 보다 우선하는지; nav::Ctx::home 이 3번을 어디에 그리는지. cargo test 안 돌림.

text:
moai-88l8 가 `src/user_config.rs` 에 기반을 깔았다. 부를 것:

- 자리: `user_config::path()` → `Option<PathBuf>`. `None` 이면 `HOME` 도 없는 기계라 쓰기는 멈춘다
- `add <dir>`: `let dir = user_config::resolve_dir(input, &cwd)?;` (상대경로를 cwd 에 붙이고 **심볼릭 링크를 푼다**, 없으면 `not_found`, 파일이면 `bad_input`) → `user_config::update(&path, |doc| doc.add(&dir))?` 가 `true`(새로 넣음)/`false`(이미 있음, 멱등). `.moai` 유무는 부르는 쪽이 `dir.join(".moai").is_dir()` 로 보고 "init 전" 을 알린다
- `rm <dir>`: `user_config::update(&path, |doc| Ok(doc.remove(&user_config::spellings(input, &cwd))))?` 가 뺀 수. 0 이면 "등록돼 있지 않다". 디렉터리가 이미 없어도 글자 철자로 찾는다
- `ls`: `user_config::read(path.as_deref())` → `Registry { path, projects: Vec<Project{path}>, problems: Vec<String> }`. **실패하지 않는다** — 깨진 파일·못 읽는 항목은 `problems` 한 줄씩. 비영 종료하지 말 것
- 쓰기 실패 코드: 깨진 파일 `broken`, 락 5초 `locked`, 상대/UTF-8 아닌 경로 `bad_input`
- 이름·`.moai` 유무·이슈 수는 파생값이라 파일에 적지 않는다. 필드를 더할 때는 `[[project]]` 표에 키를 더한다 (모르는 키는 이미 보존된다)
- 명령이 생기면 `main.rs` 의 `mod user_config` 위 `expect(dead_code)` 가 낡았다고 알린다 — 다 쓰이면 걷는다

moai-88l8 가 `src/user_config.rs` 에 기반을 깔았다. `.moai` 밖 한눈 보기가 부를 것:

- `user_config::read(user_config::path().as_deref())` → `Registry { path, projects, problems }`. **실패하지 않는다.** 파일이 없으면 빈 목록(등록 안 한 사람의 정상), 깨졌으면 목록이 비고 `problems` 에 한 줄. `problems` 는 그대로 한 줄씩 비추고 비영 종료하지 않는다
- `projects` 는 파일 차례 그대로, 같은 경로는 한 번만. `Project::path` 는 절대경로다. `moai project add` 로 넣은 것은 심볼릭 링크를 푼 물리 경로지만 **손으로 적은 줄은 링크 철자일 수 있다** — "지금 선 저장소가 등록한 것인가" 를 견줄 때는 `std::fs::canonicalize` 를 한 번 거쳐 `Repo::root`(`current_dir()` 에서 온 물리 경로)와 견준다
- 프로젝트마다 `Repo` 를 여는 길은 아직 없다(`Repo::discover` 가 cwd 에서만 찾는다). 디렉터리를 받아 여는 생성자를 `store` 에 두고, `.moai` 없음·설정 깨짐·스냅샷 깨짐을 그 프로젝트의 한 줄로 바꾸는 것은 이 이슈의 몫이다
- 시험은 `tests/cli.rs` 의 `isolated()` 가 이미 `MOAI_CONFIG` 를 없는 파일로 준다. 등록이 필요한 시험은 제 임시 디렉터리 밑 파일로 `.env("MOAI_CONFIG", …)` 를 덮는다

title: 리뷰 — 사용자 단위 설정 모듈 user_config
temp+rename 쓰기가 파일 권한(chmod 600 등)을 기본값으로 되돌린다 — store::write_atomic 과 user_config::update 둘 다

text:
## /code-review high --fix d9ecc79 — 원문

I reviewed commit `d9ecc79` (the new user-level config module, `src/user_config.rs`) and found two real bugs. I fixed both in the working tree; nothing is committed. There was no ReportFindings tool available to me, so the findings are listed here only.

**Findings**

1. `src/user_config.rs:128` (medium): `update` breaks a symlinked config file. It writes a temp file and renames it onto `path`. If `~/.config/moai/config.toml` is a symlink into a dotfiles repo (stow, chezmoi and the like), the rename swaps the link for a plain file. The dotfiles copy keeps the old contents and the user gets no warning. A throwaway test confirmed it: after `update`, the path was no longer a symlink and the target file was still empty.
2. `src/user_config.rs:311` (low): `spellings` can't remove a path that `resolve_dir` registered through `link/..`. When registering, `resolve_dir` follows the link before applying `..`, so `cwd/link/..` (with `link -> /else/real`) is stored as `/else`. `spellings` removes `..` as text first (giving `cwd`) and only then resolves links. So `remove link/..` gets only `cwd` and finds nothing to remove. The probe confirmed it: registered as `.../else`, spellings gave `[.../cwd]`.

**Fixes (both in `src/user_config.rs`)**
- **Symlink:** `update` now resolves the config path with `canonicalize` before it creates the directory, takes the lock, reads and renames. The file the link points to gets rewritten and the link stays. If the file doesn't exist yet, the path is used as given. New test: `a_symlinked_config_stays_a_symlink`.
- **Spellings:** `spellings` now also resolves the path as typed, before `..` is removed as text, and drops duplicates. I added a `link/..` case to `resolve_dir_makes_absolute_and_follows_symlinks`.
- **Checks:** all 12 `user_config` tests pass. Clippy's only warning is an old one in `src/report.rs:2932`, which this diff didn't touch.

**Considered and not reported**
- A no-op `update` on a config that doesn't exist yet still creates the directory and a `config.toml.lock` file (not the config itself). This is cosmetic, and the lock has to exist before the file is read.
- The `rename` write resets the file's permissions (for example a `chmod 600`). `store` writes the same way.
- A hand-written `project = []` is treated as a broken file and blocks writes. That is the stated rule: `project` must be a `[[project]]` table array.
- All tests share one `MOAI_CONFIG` path. That's only a risk once a future `moai project` test (moai-54dt) writes to it without overriding the path.

## 판단

반영 (1b3c588):
- 1 링크로 건 설정 — 반영하되 **락 자리를 바꿨다.** 리뷰의 수정은 링크를 락 밖에서 풀고 락도 대상 곁에 두어, dotfiles 저장소에 `config.toml.lock` 이 흘러 추적 안 된 파일로 선다. 락은 준 자리 곁에 두고 푸는 것은 락 안으로 옮겼다. 시험에 "대상 곁에 락이 없다" 를 더했다
- 2 `link/..` 철자 — 그대로 반영

넘긴 것:
- 없는 설정에 아무것도 안 하는 update 가 디렉터리와 락 파일을 만든다 — 락은 읽기 전에 있어야 하고, update 는 `project add|rm` 만 부른다. 고치지 않는다
- rename 이 권한을 되돌린다 — `store` 도 같다. 둘을 함께 고칠 일이라 **moai-gv1c** (idea) 로 담았다
- `project = []` 를 깨진 파일로 본다 — 정한 규칙이다. 모르는 모양의 `project` 에 더하면 남의 값을 덮는다
- 시험이 한 `MOAI_CONFIG` 자리를 함께 쓴다 — 아직 쓰는 시험이 없다. **moai-54dt** 에 "쓰는 시험은 제 임시 파일로 덮는다" 를 적었다

moai-6au6 쪽에서 디렉터리 하나를 여는 생성자를 `src/store.rs` 에 정했다 (6au6 워크트리 브랜치에 커밋, 합쳐지기 전):

```rust
pub enum Opened { Repo(Repo), Uninit, Missing }
impl Repo {
    pub fn open(dir: &Path) -> R<Opened>;   // 준 디렉터리 그 자리의 .moai 만 연다. 위로 찾지 않는다
    pub fn find() -> R<Option<Repo>>;       // discover 와 같되 못 찾으면 None (설정 깨짐은 Err)
}
```

- `Opened::Repo(repo)` → `repo.read()?` 로 `Load { issues, errors }`. 칸별 수가 필요하면 `report::status(&load.issues, &[], &repo.config, &model::now()).counts`
- `Uninit` = 디렉터리는 있고 `.moai/` 가 없다(init 전). `Missing` = 디렉터리가 없다(경로 중간이 파일인 것 포함)
- `Err` = `.moai/config.toml` 이 깨졌거나, 등록한 경로가 파일이거나, 권한 따위로 못 읽는다 — 상태가 아니라 그 프로젝트의 한 줄로 말할 것
- 위로 안 찾는 까닭: 등록한 경로는 사람이 댄 프로젝트 뿌리다. 모노레포에서 `.moai` 없는 하위 디렉터리가 바깥 저장소의 이슈를 제 이름으로 내면 같은 이슈가 두 프로젝트에 두 번 선다
- 6au6 는 이 위에 `src/projects.rs`(등록 목록을 읽어 프로젝트마다 이름·상태)를 얹지만, 54dt 는 거기 기대지 않고 `Repo::open` 만으로 된다

moai-6au6 가 CLI 한눈 보기를 깔았다. 색을 얹을 자리:

- 데이터: `projects::open(&Registry) -> Vec<Project>`. `Project { path, name, state }`, `state` 는 `State::{Open { repo, load }, Uninit, Missing, Unreadable(String)}`. 줄은 한데 모이지 않는다 — 프로젝트마다 제 `Load` 를 들고 있어, "이 줄이 어느 프로젝트 것인가" 는 늘 바깥 `Project` 가 답한다
- **색 배정은 `path` 로 한다.** `name` 은 디렉터리 이름이고 겹치면 위 디렉터리를 붙인 파생값이라(`projects::names`) 등록 목록이 바뀌면 달라진다. 경로는 등록한 철자 그대로다
- 사람 화면: `view::projects_status` / `view::projects_ready`. id 가 서는 줄은 모두 `  {name}{pad}{id}…` 모양이다 — 이름 칸(`cell(style::PLAIN, &p.name, w_name + 2)`)과 id 칸(`style::ID`)에 프로젝트 색을 얹으면 된다. 머리 줄 `project_head` 의 이름(`style::HEAD`)도 같은 색이 좋다
- 색을 끈 화면에서도 이미 이름이 id 곁에 서므로 "색이 혼자 뜻을 지지 않는다" 는 지켜져 있다. 시험 `outside_a_repo_each_registered_project_stands_apart_even_with_the_same_ids` 가 `NO_COLOR` 에서 `two/api  <id>` 를 본다
- `--json` 에는 색이 없다. 필요하면 프로젝트 줄(`projects::Entry`)에 필드를 더한다

moai-6au6 가 깐 것 — 프로젝트 층이 쓸 데이터:

- `store::Repo::open(dir) -> R<Opened>`, `Opened::{Repo(Repo), Uninit, Missing}` — 준 디렉터리 그 자리의 `.moai` 만 연다(위로 찾지 않는다). `Err` 는 설정이 깨졌거나 파일이거나 권한. `Repo::find() -> R<Option<Repo>>` 는 cwd 에서 위로 찾되 못 찾으면 `None` — "`.moai` 밖에서 띄웠나" 를 이것으로 가른다(설정 깨짐은 `Err` 라 프로젝트 층으로 새지 않는다)
- `projects::open(&user_config::read(user_config::path().as_deref())) -> Vec<Project>` — 등록 차례 그대로, 실패하지 않는다. `Project { path, name, state: State::{Open { repo, load }, Uninit, Missing, Unreadable(String)} }`. 프로젝트 줄(이름·경로·칸별 수·집은 것)은 `Open` 에서 `report::status(&load.issues, …).counts` 와 `report::wip(&load.issues, &repo.config)` 로 센다 — CLI 의 `cmd::status::overview` 가 그렇게 한다
- `Project::seen(|repo, load| …) -> Seen<T>` 로 연 것만 셈하고 나머지 상태는 그대로 받는다. `Seen::map` 으로 모양을 바꾼다
- **줄을 합치지 않는다.** 같은 id 가 두 프로젝트에 있을 수 있다(시험이 복사한 `.moai` 로 본다). 커서·`nav::Seg` 는 프로젝트를 한 단계로 들 때 이름이 아니라 **경로**를 정체로 삼는다 — `name` 은 겹침을 가르려 붙인 파생값이라 등록 목록이 바뀌면 달라진다
- 다시 읽기: 프로젝트마다 `repo.issues_path()` 를 `store::stamp` 로 재면 된다. `projects::open` 은 한 번 읽고 끝이라 지켜보기는 받는 쪽 몫이다
- 사람이 읽을 낱말(init 전 / 디렉터리가 없다 / 못 읽는다)은 `view::unopened` 에 있다(지금은 비공개). TUI 도 같은 말을 쓰려면 그것을 열어 쓴다

text:
리뷰 원문 — `/code-review high --fix main...HEAD` (0ca060d, df65b56)

I reviewed `main...HEAD` (df65b56, 0ca060d). I found no correctness bugs. Tests pass (535 unit, 215 CLI), and I ran the new overview by hand against four registered projects: one working, one with a broken snapshot, one without `.moai` yet, and one whose directory is gone. `status`, `ready`, `--json` and bare `moai` all did what they should: exit 0, `(데이터가 깨졌다 1건)` shown for the broken snapshot, and write commands still stop outside a repo. The ReportFindings tool isn't available in this session, so the findings are listed here only.

## Findings

1. **src/projects.rs:81 (low, fixed)** — The overview's `--json` calls a directory with no `.moai` `"state":"uninit"`. On `main`, `moai project ls --json` (landed in parallel as moai-54dt) calls the same state `"uninitialized"`. Once both merge, a script reading both commands has to know two words for one state, and renaming later would break whoever already reads the output.
2. **src/view.rs:1214 (low, fixed)** — In the `status` overview, each picked row padded its id to that id's own width, not a width shared by the rows shown. If a short id and a child id like `x-1a2b.3` are both picked, the glyph and title columns don't line up. `projects_ready` already shared the width, so the two views were inconsistent.
3. **src/projects.rs:356, src/view.rs:765, src/store.rs:128 (low, cleanup, not fixed)** — This branch rebuilds things `main` got in the meantime:
   - `projects::names` is the same algorithm as `main`'s `user_config::names`, whose doc says `ls`, the overview and the TUI should share it.
   - `view::shell_arg` does the same job as `cmd/project.rs::shell_word`, but decides what to quote differently (a list of bad characters vs. a list of safe ones).
   - `Repo::open` makes `project.rs::inspect` redundant; `main`'s comment says `inspect` should call it once this lands.
   - `main`'s `project ls` strips control characters from paths and names, and the overview prints them as they are.

   The merge itself is clean (`git merge-tree` shows no conflicts), but after it there will be two copies of each helper that can drift apart.

## Fixes applied
- **#1:** added `#[serde(rename = "uninitialized")]` to `Seen::Uninit` and updated the expected string in `outside_a_repo_the_overview_speaks_json` (tests/cli.rs).
- **#2:** `projects_status` now takes the rows it shows, computes one id width over them, and pads with that.

## Skipped
- **#3:** the shared helpers only exist on `main`, so the fix belongs in the merge (or right after it), not in this branch. Whoever merges should:
  - drop `projects::names` for `user_config::names`;
  - use one shell-quoting helper;
  - have `project ls` call `Repo::open`;
  - strip control characters in the overview view.

title: project ls 에 칸별 이슈 수와 깨진 .moai 한 줄 — Repo::open(moai-6au6) 이 들어온 뒤
리뷰 — moai project add|ls|rm (3beacf0)

text:
I found 2 real bugs in `3beacf0^..3beacf0` and fixed both. The fixes are in the worktree and not committed. There is no ReportFindings tool in this session, so the findings are only listed here.

## Findings

1. **`src/user_config.rs:325` (`spellings`, used by `project::rm`) — medium.** `moai project rm` can't remove a deleted directory if a parent of that path is a symlink.
   - **Why:** `add` saves the path with symlinks resolved. Once the directory is gone, `rm` tries the path as typed and the fully resolved path. The typed path doesn't match what was saved, and resolving fails because the directory no longer exists.
   - **Scenario:** a user adds `/tmp/foo` on macOS, which is saved as `/private/tmp/foo`, then deletes `foo` and runs `moai project rm /tmp/foo`. The command says "등록돼 있지 않다" and exits 0, but the entry stays and `ls` keeps showing it as missing. A home directory reached through a symlink behaves the same way.
   - **Reproduced:** on Linux with a symlinked parent directory, `rm` printed "등록돼 있지 않다" and `ls` still listed the path.

2. **`src/cmd/project.rs:48` (`add`, the init hint) — low.** The suggested command `moai -C {shown} init` doesn't quote the path.
   - **Scenario:** for `~/My Projects/argos`, the pasted command splits the path into two arguments and fails.
   - **Reproduced** with a directory named `sp ace`.

## Fixes
- **Finding 1:** `spellings` now also resolves the deepest parent that still exists and puts the rest of the path back on, via a new helper `real_prefix`. A deleted directory under a symlinked parent now matches the saved path. I added a check for this (`link/gone` → `real/gone`) to the existing test `resolve_dir_makes_absolute_and_follows_symlinks`.
- **Finding 2:** added `shell_word`, which wraps the path in single quotes when it contains spaces or shell-special characters (and escapes `'`), plus a unit test. Plain paths print unchanged.
- **Verified:**
  - `cargo test` passes (534 unit and 216 integration tests).
  - The release build succeeds.
  - Re-running the repro script now prints "뺌" for the deleted directory and quotes the spaced path in the hint.
  - Clippy's only warning is an old one in `src/report.rs:2964`, which this change doesn't touch.

## Checked and not reported
- **`names()`:** it always terminates. Two equal names always come from the same depth, so only the entries that actually clash grow.
- **Positional field named `path`:** it no longer clashes with the global `-C` option.
- **Hook rule 1 (`creates`):** it doesn't treat `moai project add` as creating an issue.
- **`ls`:** it doesn't fail on a broken config or a missing directory.
- **`rm` without a config file:** it doesn't create anything.

## Skipped
- **`Doc::add` vs hand-written entries:** it compares paths without resolving symlinks in entries someone typed into the file. So adding the resolved path of such an entry creates a duplicate. That code predates this diff, so I left it alone.

Files changed: `src/user_config.rs`, `src/cmd/project.rs`.

text:
moai-6au6 가 들어오면서 이 이슈가 쓸 것 (6au6 브랜치, main 합류 대기):

- `store::Repo::open(dir) -> R<Opened>`, `Opened::{Repo(Repo), Uninit, Missing}` — `project.rs::inspect` 의 셋과 한 짝씩 맞는다(`Initialized`/`Uninitialized`/`Missing`). `Err` 는 깨진 `.moai/config.toml`·파일인 경로·권한이다
- 이미 연 결과가 필요하면 `projects::open(&reg) -> Vec<Project>` 가 이름(`user_config::names`)·상태·`Load` 를 한 번에 준다. `State::Unreadable(String)` 이 깨진 것의 한 줄이다. 한눈 보기(`cmd::status::overview`)는 칸별 수를 `report::status(&load.issues, &unreadable, &repo.config, &now).counts` 로 센다 — `ls` 도 같은 자로 세면 두 화면의 수가 어긋나지 않는다
- 낱말: 한눈 보기 `--json` 의 `state` 는 `ok`·`uninitialized`·`missing`·`unreadable`(+`error`). `ls` 의 `initialized` 와 `ok` 는 뜻이 다르다(ok 는 스냅샷까지 읽었다) — `ls` 에 수를 더할 때 키를 새로 두고 `state` 값은 건드리지 않는 편이 읽던 쪽을 안 깬다
- 셸 따옴표는 `text::shell_word` 로 모였다(project.rs 의 것을 옮김)

판단 — 무엇을 반영하고 무엇을 넘겼나

- 2번(status 한눈 보기의 집은 줄 id 폭): 반영 — 5d3052d
- 3번(main 과 겹치는 헬퍼): main(moai-54dt) 을 합친 뒤(merge 커밋) 반영 — 790726a

  - `project.rs::inspect` 를 `Repo::open` 으로 바꾸는 것은 넘겼다 → moai-s51k (이슈 수와 한 번에 바꾸는 것이 그 이슈의 본문이다. 메모를 남겼다)

text:
설계 — 구현 전에 정한 것 (moai-ujpu)

**자리.** `App` 은 여전히 한 프로젝트의 줄(issues·index·repo·path…)을 든다 — 지금 코드와 시험이 그 모양 위에 서 있다. 그 위에 `App::layer: Option<Layer>`(src/tui/layer.rs) 를 얹는다. `None` 이면 등록한 것이 없는 것이고 **오늘과 한 글자도 다르지 않다**(뿌리에 `..` 없음, Bksp 는 아무 일도 안 함). `Layer::at` 이 `At::Layer` 나 `At::Project(경로)` 다 — 프로젝트 층은 `nav::Seg` 의 한 마디가 아니라 **따로 선 자리**다. `nav` 는 한 프로젝트의 `&[Issue]` 만 아는 순수 모듈로 남는다.
- 불변식: `At::Project(p)` 면 `app.repo` 는 늘 `Some` 이고 그 프로젝트의 것이다. `At::Layer` 면 `repo`·`issues`·`index` 를 **비운다** — 층에서는 어느 프로젝트에도 쓸 수 없고, 옛 프로젝트의 id 가 커서 정체로 새지 않는다.
- 줄: `Row::Project(첨자)`. 커서 정체는 `Anchor::Project(경로)` — **이름이 아니라 경로**(이름은 등록 목록 전체에서 정해지는 파생값).
- 프로젝트 안 뿌리에는 층이 있을 때만 `..` 이 선다(디렉터리 비유, 층이 있다는 것을 보이게). 나오면 떠난 프로젝트 줄에 선다. 들어가면 커서는 0(`..`) — `enter` 와 같다. `.moai` 안에서 띄운 첫 화면만 첫 항목에 선다(오늘 첫 화면과 같게).

**띄운 자리.** `.moai` 안에서 띄웠는데 그 저장소가 등록돼 있지 않으면 층 맨 앞에 `여기 · 등록 안 됨` 으로 선다. 빼면 Bksp 로 올라간 뒤 내려올 길이 없다 — 디렉터리처럼 드나든다는 약속이 한 방향으로만 선다. 등록돼 있으면(`canonicalize` 로 견줌) 그 줄에 `여기` 만 붙고 따로 서지 않는다. 이름은 띄운 자리까지 넣고 `user_config::names` 로 가른다.

**층의 줄.** 이름·칸별 수(글리프+수)·경로, 상세에 칸 이름별 수·집은 것(`report::wip`)·드러난 것 수(`report::status`)·못 읽는 줄 수. init 전/디렉터리가 없다/못 읽는다는 **`view::unopened` 의 말 그대로**(`pub(crate)` 로 열고 `style::plain` 으로 색만 걷는다) — 줄에는 잘라서, 상세에는 다. 들어가려 하면(Enter) 층에 선 채 그 말을 알림으로 댄다. 들어갈 때는 늘 `Repo::open` 부터 다시 한다 — 층의 셈이 낡았어도 들어가는 것은 지금의 디렉터리다.

**다시 읽기.** 프로젝트 안에서는 오늘 그대로(그 프로젝트의 표식·옆 워크트리 표식). 층에서는 프로젝트마다 `.moai/issues.jsonl`·`.moai/config.toml` 두 표식(stat 둘)을 걸음마다 재고, 바뀐 것만 스레드에서 읽는다 — config 도 재는 까닭은 `moai init`(설정이 생김)과 깨진 설정을 고친 것을 알아채려고. **안에 있는 동안 남의 프로젝트는 안 읽는다** — 올라갈 때(Bksp, 사람의 손이라 그 자리에서) 표식이 바뀐 것만 읽는다. F5 는 층에서 사용자 설정을 다시 읽고 전부 그 자리에서 다시 연다. 사람이 누른 읽기는 도는 읽기를 버린다(오늘 `reload` 규칙). 프로젝트를 옮기면 그 프로젝트의 도는 읽기도 버리고, `Fresh` 에 뿌리를 달아 받는 쪽이 지금 프로젝트와 다르면 버린다 — 두 겹.

**`--worktree`(w).** 프로젝트 안에서만 겹친다. 층에서 `w` 는 켜지 않고 한 줄로 그렇다고 말한다. 켠 채 올라오면 켠 것은 남아 다음에 들어간 프로젝트에서 겹친다.

**거름망.** 한 프로젝트의 줄에 매인 것이라(칸 이름도 프로젝트마다 다르다) 층으로 올라가면 푼다. 층에서 `/`·`f` 는 열지 않고 한 줄로 말한다.

**쓰기.** 안에서는 오늘 그대로(`App::write` 가 `self.repo` 에). 층에서 `n` 은 폼을 안 열고 "어느 프로젝트에 담을지 — Enter 로 들어가서 n" 을 알림으로 댄다. 담을 곳을 고르는 진짜 길은 moai-fccv 가 정한다.

**띄우기.** `.moai` 밖 + 등록 있음 → 층에서 시작(그 자리에서 다 읽는다 — `moai status` 와 같은 값). 밖 + 등록 없음 → `status`·`ready` 와 같은 말로 멈춘다(`cmd::registered`). 안 → 그 프로젝트 안에서 시작, 층은 등록이 있을 때만 서고 남의 프로젝트는 처음 올라갈 때 읽는다(안에서 띄운 사람의 첫 화면을 남의 저장소 수만큼 늦추지 않는다). `--path` 는 밖에서 거절(`moai -C <dir> tui --path`). `tui --json` 밖 → 층의 줄(`kind: "project"`, `title`=이름, `path`=디렉터리, `dir`, `state`=`ok|uninitialized|missing|unreadable` — `projects::Seen` 과 같은 낱말, ok 면 `counts`·`picked`).

**색.** 프로젝트 이름을 칠하는 곳은 `draw::project_style` 하나 — moai-xs9x 의 색을 거기 얹는다.

title: 리뷰 — project ls 칸별 수·깨진 .moai (e9c146b)
한눈 보기(view::board·unopened)가 남의 설정에서 온 칸 이름의 제어문자를 거르지 않고, 못 읽는다 까닭의 줄바꿈을 펴지 않는다 — project ls 는 거른다(moai-s51k.uu0)

text:
/code-review high --fix HEAD~1..HEAD (e9c146b) 원문

I found no real bugs in `HEAD~1..HEAD` (e9c146b, moai-s51k: `project ls` now shows the issue count per column and names a broken `.moai`). There were no findings, so `--fix` changed nothing. The ReportFindings tool isn't available in this session, so the result is only in this message.

**How I checked:**
- **The code:** I read every hunk in `src/cmd/project.rs` and `tests/cli.rs`, then compared them with the code they now share: `projects::open`, `Repo::open`, `report::status`, and the `.moai`-outside `status` screen (`view::projects_status`, `unopened`).
- **Tests:** `cargo build --release` succeeds, and all 8 `project` tests in `tests/cli.rs` pass, including the new `project_ls_counts_each_column_and_names_a_broken_moai`.
- **Manual run:** I registered a working project, one with a broken `config.toml`, and a plain file. `ls` gives the column counts, a one-line "못 읽는다" with the reason, and exits 0. Its counts match the `status` screen. `--json` shows `state` (`initialized` or `unreadable`) with `counts`, `unreadable` and `error` alongside. `project add` refuses the plain file.

**Checked and fine:**
- **Same counting as `status`:** counts come from `report::status(..).counts`, so epics, milestones and deferred work are left out exactly as the `status` screen does. Columns are drawn in the config's order, and a column with no issues shows 0.
- **`--json` shape:** it keeps the old words. A healthy project is still `initialized`, the other states are unchanged, and `unreadable` is new. The internal `columns` field doesn't leak into the output.
- **Error text:** the reason is cleaned of control characters and newlines are flattened, so a multi-line config error can't break the list into extra rows.
- **Intended changes:** a registered path that became a file used to show as "디렉터리가 없다". It now shows as "못 읽는다 — 디렉터리가 아니다". A `.moai` with a broken config used to show as "있음" and now shows as unreadable. Both follow the new doc comment.

**Outside this diff (not changed, for you to decide):**
- **`src/cmd/project.rs` `add`:** it still decides `initialized` with `dir.join(".moai").is_dir()`. So `project add --json` can report `initialized: true` for a project that `ls` calls `unreadable`, which is the mismatch this commit set out to remove from `ls`.
- **`src/view.rs` `unopened`:** the `status` screen prints the unreadable reason without flattening newlines, unlike `ls` now. A multi-line error could spill across lines there.
- **Custom column names:** they are printed without cleaning, both in the new `ls` line and in `view::board`. A registered repo's config could put control characters on screen.

판단: 버그 없음. 범위 밖으로 넘긴 셋을 직접 가렸다 — (1) ls 의 칸 이름 제어문자: 반영, fix fc171e2 (sanitize + 시험에 ESC 든 statuses). (2) view::board·unopened 의 같은 구멍과 줄바꿈: view.rs 는 moai-xs9x 워크트리가 고치는 중이라 안 건드림 → idea moai-3szs. (3) project add 의 initialized 가 is_dir 인 것: add 의 initialized 는 'init 하라는 안내가 필요한가' 의 답이라 뜻이 어긋나진 않으나, 깨진 설정을 조용히 받는 것은 알릴 만함 → idea moai-nnbt

note: 버그 없음 — ls 칸 이름 제어문자 거르기 반영(fc171e2), view.rs 쪽 같은 구멍은 moai-3szs, add 의 initialized 는 moai-nnbt 로 넘김

text: 결정 (feat e9c146b, fix fc171e2): ls 는 projects::open 으로 연다(inspect 걷음). 칸별 수는 report::status(..).counts — 한눈 보기와 같은 자. --json 의 state 는 옛 낱말 그대로(연 것 = initialized, ok 로 안 바꿈) + counts·unreadable 키를 곁에, 깨진 것은 한눈 보기와 같은 unreadable+error. 그래서 projects::Seen 을 싣지 않고 ls 의 State 로 한 번 옮긴다. 등록한 경로가 파일이면 missing → unreadable 로 바뀌었다(Repo::open 이 그렇게 가른다)

text:
리뷰 원문 (/code-review high --fix, 76479e4)

I found one real problem in `76479e4` and fixed it. The rest of the new help text matches what the binary does. I couldn't submit through ReportFindings because that tool isn't available to me, so the finding is listed here.

**Finding (low):**
- `src/cli.rs:300` — The new `project ls --help` text says a broken config file is reported on stderr. That is only true for normal output. With `--json`, stderr stays empty and the error goes into the `problems` array. I checked this by running `project ls --json` against a broken config. A script calling `moai project ls --json` and watching stderr would decide the config is fine.

**Fixed:** I added one line to that help text: `(`--json` 이면 stderr 대신 `problems` 배열에 선다).` After a release rebuild all tests pass (535 + 223). This change is uncommitted in `src/cli.rs`. The changes to `.moai/issues.jsonl` and `.moai/journal.jsonl` were already there before the review started, and I didn't touch them.

**Nothing skipped.** Everything else I checked by running the release binary against a scratch config:
- Outside `.moai`, bare `moai`, `moai status` and `moai ready` show the overview of registered projects, and `--json` starts with a `projects` array.
- With no projects registered, bare `moai` prints help.
- `project add` on a folder without `.moai` warns "init 전" and still registers it. Running it again says "이미 등록돼 있다" and exits 0.
- When two folders have the same name, they're shown as `apps/a` and `libs/a`.
- Other commands run outside `.moai` fail and point to `-C`.
- The help texts that the commit says it deliberately changed from the `"\` line continuation keep their leading spaces.
- The new `PROJECTS` piece is identical in `AGENTS.md` and `references/commands.md`, and the regenerated tests (`both_surfaces_carry_the_same_pieces`, `checked_in`) pass.

판단:

- 반영: `project ls --help` 의 --json 문제 배열 (f4ff114). 깨진 MOAI_CONFIG 로 `project ls --json 2>/dev/null` 을 돌려 stderr 가 비고 `problems` 에 서며 rc=0 인 것을 직접 확인했다.
- 넘긴 것 없음. 리뷰 범위 밖으로 작업 중 발견한 둘은 idea 로 담았다 — moai-pxtk(after_help 첫 줄 들여쓰기, 다른 명령들), moai-ndo7(.moai 밖 status 가 등록 없음·깨진 사용자 설정에서 rc=1).
- 도움말 수정은 guide 조각이 아니라 cli.rs 뿐이라 AGENTS.md·플러그인 재생성은 필요 없다.
